product.name: Monoprice 5-Pin Male to 3-Pin Female DMX Converter
product.description: Connect your 3-pin and 5-pin DMX cables and equipment together using this 3-Pin Female to 5-Pin Male DMX Converter from Monoprice!This anodized aluminum adapter features a female 3-pin DMX connector with a lock release button and a male 5-pin DMX connector on the opposite end. It transmits the signal ground on pin 1 and the DMX data signals on pins 2 and 3. Please note that any auxiliary data on pins 4 and 5 will not be carried through.Warning: This product may contain a chemical known to the State of California to cause cancer, birth defects, or other reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
